title: Red Rock Casino Resort Spa (agent A, photo-sampled estimates)
notes: Phase 2 (agent A, 2026-10-29). Colour before texture (Detail p.30): each role takes a 1.18.2 block near (OkLAB, facade_palette_tools nearest) a colour sampled from a dated Wikimedia Commons photo. Samples depend on lighting, so they are ESTIMATES; colour_refs lists each with its source id (packages/red-rock-casino/sources.json). Glass: the tower glass reads blue-black in shade and bronze/rose when reflecting. Gray stained glass (nearest the reflective sample) is framed by bronze (brown stained glass) mullions and floor lines, so the bronze reads as framing (Detail pp.4-5: an odd glass colour only with other detail). Backing is gray concrete (not black behind gray glass). Zone tower-glass = the cream stucco frame and cornice around the tower glass. Zone ledgestone = the tan stacked-strip stone of the tower end piers; the rr components make it 2-tone by rows (Detail p.24). Zone podium = cream stucco with red sandstone piers. Zone entrance = the post-2014 NW casino entrance (white box canopy, red sandstone piers, wood soffit, silver letters). Sign = maroon/purple letters as seen 2010-2018 (the 2024 S-end letters read red: era noted in EVIDENCE.md). Unobserved roles (door, sill) are library defaults.
